items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: That's when I worked with Tiny Parham, yeah, and he had a band in the Savoy Ballroom

ctx.x: Yeah, then I went on to gigging, jobbing, you know. That's when I worked with Tiny Parham, yeah, and he had a band in the Savoy Ballroom, and see, every night had gone, we worked Saturdays and Sundays and different nights in the Savoy Ballroom there.
